name: origin-ui-timeline
title: Timeline
description: Compound component system (Timeline, TimelineItem, TimelineIndicator, TimelineDate, TimelineTitle, TimelineContent) for status/workflow tracking. Tracks active step via controlled (value prop) or uncontrolled (defaultValue) state. Steps…
use: Order tracking, onboarding flows, or process timelines where users follow sequential steps.
avoid: Deeply nested timelines (3+ levels of nesting): layout can become complex.
a11y: Semantic time elements for dates. Timeline steps are buttons (clickable) with active state. Supports keyboard navigation if wrapped in proper focus management.
